open_leads.title: CVE-2026-119618 exploitation status conflicts between CSA and vendor/researcher pages
open_leads.note: CSA (17 Nov) says exploitation is reportedly active and a PoC is public. On 16 Nov, the day before CSA's alert, F5 Labs said 'we have observed no major exploit activity' and Orca said 'no confirmed in-the-wild exploitation has been reported'. Both say Red Hat reports public research with a reliable exploit against a default configuration, and both rate it CVSS 9.8 (CSA gives 8.1). Both note that standalone mod_h2 2.0.8-2.0.42 is archived and has no fix. The record already says 'reportedly' and attributes it to CSA, so nothing was changed. Watch for a CISA KEV entry or a vendor or government statement of observed exploitation. If one appears, add it and consider the 'poc-public' tag; CSA's 'publicly available' PoC statement may already support that tag.
